description: This file defines the PHP class TemplateAddressCountry, which extends the TemplateEnum class to represent a country selection field for address forms in SuiteCRM. It includes methods to generate field definitions with predefined options and groupings, and references external PHP files for parent class and utility functions.

classes.name: TemplateAddressCountry
classes.description: A PHP class representing a country selection field in address forms, extending the TemplateEnum class with additional group property and customized field definition logic.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Constructs and returns the field definition array, including options 'countries_dom' and the group property.
